info.name: Sanad App — Family reviews and medical access
info.description: Family booking reviews, dependent help acknowledgement, named medical-caregiver grants, and the equipment-rental clause 8 lifecycle (catalog browsing, booking, Paymob payment, full-refund cancellation, unused-days refunds and deduction disputes). Use disposable fixtures; no credentials are included.

item.name: Review completed booking
item.description: Family owner/editor only, after Completed. One immutable review per booking; success is 201.

item.name: Acknowledge dependent help request
item.description: FamilyAccess; dependent must belong to the caller’s family and the request must be pending.

item.name: Create named caregiver grant
item.description: Owner/editor only. Grantee must be an active Medical caregiver; multiple named recipients are supported. Duplicate active dependent/grantee grants are rejected. E03 audits successful grant creation and Families.AccessDenied authorization denials at this operation. Invalid/inactive grantee, duplicate grant, malformed request, and framework auth failures are not audited.

item.name: List grant recipients
item.description: Family members only. Active Medical caregivers with userId for grant creation; hasActiveGrant marks an existing active grant. No medical records are returned.

item.name: Revoke dependent grant
item.description: Revokes the grant and preserves revocation actor/time; success is 204. E03 audits successful revocation and Families.AccessDenied authorization denials at this operation. Unknown grant, malformed request, and framework auth failures are not audited.

item.name: 04. Equipment rentals
item.description: The clause 8 equipment-rental lifecycle (refund contract; Owner decisions #10, #19-#22). The catalog displays the exact prepaid terms before purchase; booking snapshots those terms, and later catalog edits never change the snapshot. The payment intent total is always the snapshotted rent plus deposit and its idempotency key is the rnt_-prefixed merchant order id the shared Paymob webhook confirms. Refund awards are always policy-derived server-side: the family chooses only a destination (1 OriginalPaymentMethod, 2 AppCredit) — bank/wallet transfers are refused (400 Rentals.Refund.DestinationUnavailable) — and may replay an idempotencyKey; a replay returns the original outcome with isReplay true rather than moving money twice. Amounts cross the wire as exact EGP piastre integers in requests and EGP major-unit decimals in responses.

item.name: List rental catalog
item.description: Returns 200 with every active rentable item and its exact pre-purchase terms: daily rate, refundable deposit and maximum rental length. Inactive items never appear. Amounts are EGP major-unit decimals.

item.name: Get rental catalog item
item.description: Returns 200 with one active item's terms, or 404 Rentals.Catalog.NotFound when it does not exist or is inactive.

item.name: Create rental booking
item.description: Books an active item for 1..maximumRentalDays whole prepaid 24-hour periods; the response snapshot (`dailyRate`, `deposit`, `prepaidRent`, `totalPayable`) is the exact booked terms and never changes afterwards. deliveryAddress is optional (trimmed, max 500 characters). 400 Rentals.Booking.Invalid; 404 Rentals.Booking.FamilyNotFound / Rentals.Booking.EquipmentNotFound (missing or inactive item).

item.name: List my rental bookings
item.description: Returns 200 with the caller's family bookings ordered by newest first, each with status (1 PendingPayment, 2 Confirmed, 3 CancelledBeforeDelivery, 4 Delivered, 5 Returned, 6 DepositSettled), captured total, lifecycle timestamps, damage deductions with dispute states, and recorded refund movements. 404 Rentals.Booking.FamilyNotFound.

item.name: Get rental booking
item.description: Returns 200 with one of the family's own bookings, or 404 Rentals.Booking.NotFound when it does not exist or belongs to another family.

item.name: Create rental payment intent
item.description: method is 1 Card or 2 Wallet. Returns 200 with the Paymob checkout key and the rnt_-prefixed merchant order id; the intent amount is the snapshotted rent plus deposit and is never caller-supplied. E04 gates apply before any state is written: maintenance or a disabled/unconfigured method is 503 with the platform-control error, and a replay-capable pending intent is replaced by a fresh one (the old intention expires unused at the gateway). 400/404 lifecycle errors use the Rentals.Booking.* codes.

item.name: Cancel rental booking before delivery
item.description: Clause 8: before delivery the booking refunds everything captured (snapshotted rent plus deposit, Owner decision #4 ceiling) through the chosen destination. Unpaid bookings cancel with reason CancelledWithoutCapture and no money moves; captured ones return reason CancelledWithFullRefund with the Finance refundCaseId. Replaying the same idempotencyKey returns the original outcome with isReplay true. 400 Rentals.Booking.Invalid (wrong derived state) / Rentals.Refund.DestinationUnavailable; 404 Rentals.Booking.*; 409 Rentals.Booking.InvalidOperation (already delivered and beyond this flow) or Rentals.Booking.Conflict.

item.name: Claim unused-days refund
item.description: Early return after delivery: the award is the unused whole prepaid 24-hour periods at the snapshotted rate (Owner decision #19 — a started period counts as used, the clock anchored to actual delivery), computed server-side from the recorded delivery/return times; a return after the prepaid horizon computes exactly zero and the zero award is still a valid, attributable outcome. Reason UnusedDaysRefunded with the Finance refundCaseId; replays return isReplay true. 400 Rentals.Refund.* / Rentals.Booking.Invalid; 404 Rentals.Booking.*; 409 Rentals.Booking.InvalidOperation or Rentals.Booking.Conflict.

item.name: Dispute damage deduction
item.description: Records the family's dispute of a documented damage deduction (Owner decision #21) at most once per deduction; the dispute is append-only evidence and never rewrites or deletes the deduction. reason is optional (trimmed, max 1000 characters). Returns 204. 404 Rentals.Operations.BookingNotFound / DeductionNotFound (also for another family's booking or deduction); 409 Rentals.Operations.InvalidOperation (already disputed or resolved) or Conflict.
